messages:
Jana (AE): heads up — Sierra legal/infra just sent a security questionnaire and wants to POC a 40B qlora variant. main asks: customer-managed KMS, EU-only residency, and committed pricing. Can SE/eng weigh in?
Rohit (SE): do we have a verified variant for qlora 40b in catalog? last I checked only Llama2/Redwood-verified 30/34b variants. :thinking:
Maya (ML Eng): we don’t have an official catalog entry for 'sierra-qlora-40b' yet. it looks like community QLoRA weights. compatibility issues: KV cache layout differs if weights are fused/quantized with custom code.
Maya (ML Eng): short checklist from ML side:
- need FP16 or q4f16 quantization for runtime compatibility
- test KV cache correctness with long-context (8k+)
- ensure tokenizer matches (vocab/version)
Rohit (SE): for POC should we surface a supported variant like `sierra-qlora-40b-q4f16` as a temporary catalog item? that way routing/billing works.
Carlos (Infra Eng): important infra constraints:
- A100 80GB can serve q4f16 1-2 concurrent for 8k token windows with batching
- H100 better for throughput if they want low-latency at scale
- EU residency: need Dedicated in eu-west1 or Private VPC in their cloud
Priya (Security): on the SOC2/questionnaire side — they want customer KMS + key rotation + audit logs forwarded. we can support KMS but Private deployment preferred for full E2E control. remote-hosted + CMEK is possible but they flagged it.
Jana (AE): pricing angle — customer asked for committed 3mo at ~2x hosted rate because model is custom. is there precedent for custom-model uplift?
Rohit (SE): precedent: for custom weights we usually add a 1.5-2.5x multiplier depending on engineering support & validation effort. recommend reserved Dedicated for predictability.
Maya (ML Eng): ops note: to avoid retraining quant bits, recommend we run a small validation harness (1000 prompts) for regression and perf. estimate: ~2 engineer-days + 1 infra day.
Jana (AE): can we get an ops/price proposal to share with customer by EOD tomorrow?
Carlos (Infra Eng): rough infra estimate for POC (2 QPS, 8k window):
```
- 1x A100-80GB ded node for baseline (dev)
- 1x A100-80GB for canary (staging)
- autoscale into H100 for burst if they want low latency at higher QPS
```
Rohit (SE): routing/fallback: we should configure automatic fallback to a smaller 13B quant variant if Dedicated capacity constrained. keep A/B rollout to test quality delta.
Priya (Security): blockers in questionnaire: data retention policy specifics, PCI/PHI clauses, and KMS attestation. I'll draft the answers but need infra confirmation for Private vs Hosted + CMEK.
Jana (AE): action items:
- Rohit: create a temp catalog entry `sierra-qlora-40b-q4f16` and run compatibility smoke (kv cache + tokenizer) — target tomorrow noon
- Maya: validation harness + perf run estimate (1k prompts) — target EOD today
- Carlos: confirm EU dedicated availability and rough POC cost — target EOD today
- Priya: draft SOC2/questionnaire responses and list missing items — target EOD today
- Jana: consolidate and send pricing + SOW to customer by EOD tomorrow
deploy-bot: deploy artifact created for temp-variant `sierra-qlora-40b-q4f16` (id: dep-8792) :rocket:
Rohit (SE): noted. will also include fallback policy config `fallback: sierra-13b-q4f16` in the catalog entry.
Maya (ML Eng): quick tip — enable prefix/KV caching in POC to cut token costs by ~30% for their use-case. add as recommendation in the SOW.
Jana (AE): thanks team — I'll loop in customer with a recap after we have numbers. :thumbsup:
Priya (Security): posting link to questionnaire for reference: https://s3.company-internal/example-sierra-soc2-qa.pdf
Carlos (Infra Eng): pinging infra-ops in case we need quota increases: @infra-ops
Rohit (SE): +1 to prefix cache, and will include a small snippet for config in the SOW:
```
model: sierra-qlora-40b-q4f16
cache:
  prefix: true
  ttl_secs: 3600
fallback:
  - sierra-13b-q4f16
```
Jana (AE): we'll reconvene here once the artifact smoke passes. thanks!
